label: COLLECTIVE_DIVERGENCE
fix_claim: Removed the rank-0-only branch in sync_grads that issues a broadcast instead of all_reduce for bucket 0 from step 7, so every rank enters the same all_reduce and the collective no longer diverges.
patch:
--- a/job/train.py
+++ b/job/train.py
@@ -404,10 +404,7 @@
             comm.broadcast(bucket, step, b)
             bucket.div_(comm.world)
         else:

-                comm.broadcast(bucket, step, b)
-            else:
-                comm.all_reduce(bucket, step, b)
+            comm.all_reduce(bucket, step, b)
